title: Converge bounded cognition with canonical GREG execution
problem: A sandbox cortex does not produce durable governed GREG behavior. Competing seed branches risk another runtime.
baseline: PR137 persistent missions, no cognition/1; PR141 sandbox-only structured cortex.

roles.position: Preserve the entire directive, not just its currently executable slice. This is one agent applying distinct perspectives, not five independent reviewers.

roles.position: One GREG runtime and one Cortex owner; reuse PR137/141 and the canonical registry. This is one agent applying distinct perspectives, not five independent reviewers.

roles.position: Static routing is sufficient; the new experiment has not demonstrated gain. This is one agent applying distinct perspectives, not five independent reviewers.

roles.position: Bound workers and recover durable results after real process death. This is one agent applying distinct perspectives, not five independent reviewers.
material_concerns: Separate algorithms still share premises, author and runtime.

roles.position: A proof can verify computation while the premises, harm and empirical truth remain unresolved. This is one agent applying distinct perspectives, not five independent reviewers.

evidence.claim: Two different methods run under signed scope and survive process replacement
evidence.finding: Both receipt-before-action and post-action SIGKILL tests pass.

counterevidence.claim: Router is superior to the simplest deployable router
counterevidence.finding: Timing-independent gain is zero; model baselines unavailable. Reject superiority.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Bounded, durable, governable computation with honest proof limits.

advantages.amplified_value: Use native solvers rather than ask a model to invent exact answers.
Prevent a quotation, causal assumption or satisfiable model from claiming world validity.
Canonical grants and manifest compatibility reduce integration duplication.

advantages.statement: durable memory — Append observations and corrections
advantages.amplified_value: Retain failures and missing scores without policy promotion.

advantages.statement: founder control — Signed scope and stop
advantages.amplified_value: Keep execution governable through process replacement.

entries.position: Do not claim the complete seed or routing superiority.

migration_plan: Stack on PR137; preserve the 25 PR141 commits and freeze, move newly written pure methods into cortex/seed, register cognition capabilities only through existing GenomeRegistry. Keep main unchanged.

steps: Keep the draft unmerged or revert the additive integration commits.
Retain source, receipts, negative evidence and PR141 baseline; do not delete runtime history.
Use existing signed detach/lifecycle/STOP mechanisms on any explicitly configured development body.

kill_criteria: Any authority expansion, unauthorized external effect or refusal reroute.
Freeze/evaluator contamination used to claim advantage.
Repeated failure to beat simpler architecture before proposed learned routing activation.
decision_owner: Kernel/GREG maintainers within authorized development; Alfonso owns consequential decisions
review_trigger: Residual requirement closure, licensed local model evidence, or any proposed live activation.
